func TestEnsureCreatesOrdinaryHierarchyAndReusesFingerprint(t *testing.T) {
	generated := newGeneratedRepositoryFake()
	courses := &courseRepositoryFake{}
	courseI18n := &courseI18nRepositoryFake{}
	modules := &moduleRepositoryFake{}
	moduleI18n := &moduleI18nRepositoryFake{}
	sections := &sectionRepositoryFake{}
	sectionI18n := &sectionI18nRepositoryFake{}
	lessons := &lessonRepositoryFake{}
	lessonI18n := &lessonI18nRepositoryFake{}
	examples := &lessonExampleRepositoryFake{}
	tasks := &taskRepositoryFake{}
	relations := &relationRepositoryFake{}
	useCase := Ensure{
		Generated: generated, Courses: courses, CourseI18n: courseI18n,
		Modules: modules, ModuleI18n: moduleI18n, CourseModules: relations,
		Sections: sections, SectionI18n: sectionI18n, ModuleSections: relations,
		Lessons: lessons, LessonI18n: lessonI18n, SectionLessons: relations,
		Examples: examples, Tasks: tasks, TaskI18n: &taskI18nRepositoryFake{},
		TaskTargets: &taskTargetRepositoryFake{}, StructureTypes: structureTypeRepositoryFake{},
		I18n: &i18nRepositoryFake{entry: domain.I18n{ID: 1, Language: "ru"}}, Tx: transactionFake{},
		IDs: &sequenceIDs{values: []string{
			"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		}},
		Clock: fixedClock{time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}
	input := generatedCourseFixture()
	first, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ensure first Course: %v", err)
	}
	if first.Reused || first.CourseID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected first result: %#v", first)
	}
	if len(courses.items) != 1 || courses.items[0].Status != domain.CourseStatusActive ||
		courses.items[0].CatalogVisible {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Course row: %#v", courses.items)
	}
	if len(modules.items) != 1 || modules.items[0].Visibility != domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly ||
		len(sections.items) != 1 || len(lessons.items) != 1 ||
		lessons.items[0].Status != domain.LessonStatusActive || lessons.items[0].Description == "" ||
		len(examples.items) != 1 || len(tasks.items) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected hierarchy: modules=%#v sections=%#v lessons=%#v", modules.items, sections.items, lessons.items)
	}
	if len(generated.courseRecords) != 1 || len(generated.lessonRecords) != 1 || len(relations.calls) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("missing generated metadata or placements: generated=%#v relations=%#v", generated, relations.calls)
	}

	replay, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", input)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(replay, first) || len(courses.items) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("idempotent replay: result=%#v err=%v courses=%d", replay, err, len(courses.items))
	}
	reused, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", input)
	if err != nil || !reused.Reused || reused.CourseID != first.CourseID || len(courses.items) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("fingerprint reuse: result=%#v err=%v courses=%d", reused, err, len(courses.items))
	}
}

func TestEnsureRejectsIdempotencyKeyWithDifferentBody(t *testing.T) {
	generated := newGeneratedRepositoryFake()
	dependencies := configuredEnsureForExistingRequest(generated)
	input := generatedCourseFixture()
	first, err := dependencies.Handle(context.Background(), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", input)
	if err != nil || first.CourseID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("first ensure: result=%#v err=%v", first, err)
	}
	input.Title = "Different title"
	if _, err := dependencies.Handle(
		context.Background(), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", input,
	); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestEnsureSupportsLazyPracticeMaterialAsOneOrdinaryLesson(t *testing.T) {
	generated := newGeneratedRepositoryFake()
	useCase := configuredEnsureForExistingRequest(generated)
	input := generatedCourseFixture()
	input.FingerprintVersion = "practice-material-fingerprint-v1"
	input.GoalCode = "practice-prerequisite"
	input.Title = "CSS Grid"
	input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].Targets = []domain.CourseTargetRef{
		{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "css.grid", Version: "v1"},
	}
	input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].Prerequisites = nil
	input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].TransitionKnowledge = nil
	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ensure practice material: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Reused || len(result.Lessons) != 1 || len(result.Lessons[0].Targets) != 1 ||
		result.Lessons[0].Targets[0].Key != "css.grid" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected material result: %+v", result)
	}
	if len(generated.courseRecords) != 1 || generated.courseRecords[0].FingerprintVersion != "practice-material-fingerprint-v1" {
		t.Fatalf("missing material provenance: %+v", generated.courseRecords)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedCourseTitleLimitsCountUnicodeCharacters(t *testing.T) {
	input := generatedCourseFixture()
	title := strings.Repeat("я", 200)
	input.Title = title
	input.Modules[0].Title = title
	input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Title = title
	input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].Title = title
	input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].Examples[0].Title = title
	input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0].Tasks[0].Title = title
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeGeneratedCourse(input); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid Unicode titles were rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestEnsureRejectsCourseAboveDocumentedPayloadLimit(t *testing.T) {
	input := generatedCourseFixture()
	base := input.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0]
	input.Modules[0].Sections = nil
	lessonNumber := 0
	for sectionIndex := range 3 {
		section := domain.GeneratedCourseSection{
			Code: fmt.Sprintf("section-%d", sectionIndex), Title: "Section", Order: sectionIndex,
		}
		count := 167
		if sectionIndex == 2 {
			count = 166
		}
		for index := range count {
			lesson := base
			lesson.Code = fmt.Sprintf("lesson-%d", lessonNumber)
			lesson.Order = index
			lesson.DescriptionMarkdown = strings.Repeat("x", 40_000)
			section.Lessons = append(section.Lessons, lesson)
			lessonNumber++
		}
		input.Modules[0].Sections = append(input.Modules[0].Sections, section)
	}
	_, err := configuredEnsureForExistingRequest(newGeneratedRepositoryFake()).Handle(
		context.Background(), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", input,
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected payload limit validation, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestEnsureRejectsMissingQuizStructureTypeRecord(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := configuredEnsureForExistingRequest(newGeneratedRepositoryFake())
	useCase.StructureTypes = missingStructureTypeRepositoryFake{}
	_, err := useCase.Handle(
		context.Background(), "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", generatedCourseFixture(),
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func configuredEnsureForExistingRequest(generated *generatedRepositoryFake) Ensure {
	relations := &relationRepositoryFake{}
	return Ensure{
		Generated: generated, Courses: &courseRepositoryFake{}, CourseI18n: &courseI18nRepositoryFake{},
		Modules: &moduleRepositoryFake{}, ModuleI18n: &moduleI18nRepositoryFake{}, CourseModules: relations,
		Sections: &sectionRepositoryFake{}, SectionI18n: &sectionI18nRepositoryFake{}, ModuleSections: relations,
		Lessons: &lessonRepositoryFake{}, LessonI18n: &lessonI18nRepositoryFake{}, SectionLessons: relations,
		Examples: &lessonExampleRepositoryFake{}, Tasks: &taskRepositoryFake{}, TaskI18n: &taskI18nRepositoryFake{},
		TaskTargets: &taskTargetRepositoryFake{}, StructureTypes: structureTypeRepositoryFake{},
		I18n: &i18nRepositoryFake{entry: domain.I18n{ID: 1, Language: "ru"}}, Tx: transactionFake{},
		IDs: &sequenceIDs{values: []string{
			"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		}},
		Clock: fixedClock{time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}
}

func generatedCourseFixture() domain.GeneratedCourse {
	firstTarget := domain.CourseTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}
	secondTarget := domain.CourseTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}
	return domain.GeneratedCourse{
		Fingerprint:        "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
		FingerprintVersion: "course-fingerprint-v1", GoalCode: "go.backend", GoalVersion: "v1",
		Title: "Go Backend", Description: "Go for backend developers.", Language: "ru",
		Status: "ACTIVE", CatalogVisible: false, PlannerVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		PedagogyProfile: "standard-v1", PresentationStyle: "standard-v1", GenerationPolicy: "shared-v1",
		Modules: []domain.GeneratedCourseModule{{
			Code: "foundation", Title: "Foundation", Order: 0,
			Sections: []domain.GeneratedCourseSection{{
				Code: "language", Title: "Language", Order: 0,
				Lessons: []domain.GeneratedCourseLesson{{
					Code: "errors", Title: "Errors", Excerpt: "Explicit errors.", Order: 0, Status: "ACTIVE",
					Targets:       []domain.CourseTargetRef{firstTarget, secondTarget},
					Prerequisites: []domain.CourseTargetRef{firstTarget},
					TransitionKnowledge: []domain.CourseTransitionKnowledge{{
						SourceStack: "php", Target: secondTarget, Similarity: "Control flow.",
						Difference: "Explicit values.", AnalogyBoundary: "No unwinding.",
					}},
					PedagogyStrategies:  []domain.CoursePedagogyStrategyRef{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1}},
					DescriptionMarkdown: "# Explicit errors\n\nHandle errors as values.",
					Examples: []domain.GeneratedCourseExample{{
						Title: "Check an error", DescriptionMarkdown: "```go\nif err != nil {}\n```",
						PrimaryStack: "go", Stacks: []string{"go"}, TargetConcepts: []string{"errors"},
					}},
					Tasks: []domain.GeneratedCourseTask{{
						Title: "Error check", DescriptionMarkdown: "How are errors handled?",
						ExpectedAnswers: []string{"as values"},
					}},
				}},
			}},
		}},
	}
}

type generatedRepositoryFake struct {
	repository.GeneratedCourseRepository
	requests      map[string]domain.GeneratedCourseRequest
	fingerprints  map[string]string
	courseRecords []domain.GeneratedCourseRecord
	lessonRecords []domain.GeneratedLessonRecord
}

func newGeneratedRepositoryFake() *generatedRepositoryFake {
	return &generatedRepositoryFake{
		requests: make(map[string]domain.GeneratedCourseRequest), fingerprints: make(map[string]string),
	}
}

func (*generatedRepositoryFake) Lock(context.Context, string, string) error { return nil }

func (fake *generatedRepositoryFake) GetRequest(
	_ context.Context,
	key string,
) (domain.GeneratedCourseRequest, error) {
	result, ok := fake.requests[key]
	if !ok {
		return domain.GeneratedCourseRequest{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (fake *generatedRepositoryFake) GetCourseIDByFingerprint(
	_ context.Context,
	origin string,
	version string,
	fingerprint string,
) (string, error) {
	result, ok := fake.fingerprints[origin+":"+version+":"+fingerprint]
	if !ok {
		return "", domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (fake *generatedRepositoryFake) CreateCourseRecord(
	_ context.Context,
	record domain.GeneratedCourseRecord,
) error {
	fake.courseRecords = append(fake.courseRecords, record)
	fake.fingerprints[record.Origin+":"+record.FingerprintVersion+":"+record.Fingerprint] = record.CourseID
	return nil
}

func (fake *generatedRepositoryFake) CreateLessonRecord(
	_ context.Context,
	record domain.GeneratedLessonRecord,
) error {
	fake.lessonRecords = append(fake.lessonRecords, record)
	return nil
}

func (fake *generatedRepositoryFake) CreateRequest(
	_ context.Context,
	request domain.GeneratedCourseRequest,
) error {
	fake.requests[request.IdempotencyKey] = request
	return nil
}

func (fake *generatedRepositoryFake) ListLessonBindings(
	_ context.Context, courseID string,
) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error) {
	result := make([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, 0)
	for _, record := range fake.lessonRecords {
		if record.CourseID != courseID {
			continue
		}
		var targets []domain.CourseTargetRef
		if err := json.Unmarshal(record.TargetsJSON, &targets); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, domain.GeneratedLessonBinding{
			LessonID: record.LessonID, Order: len(result), Targets: targets,
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

type structureTypeRepositoryFake struct {
	repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

type missingStructureTypeRepositoryFake struct {
	repository.CodeStructureTypeRepository
}

func (missingStructureTypeRepositoryFake) GetByCode(context.Context, string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (structureTypeRepositoryFake) GetByCode(_ context.Context, code string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	if code != "QUIZ_TEXT_BASIC" {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return &domain.CodeStructureType{ID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Code: code}, nil
}

func (fake *lessonI18nRepositoryFake) Upsert(_ context.Context, item domain.LessonI18n) error {
	fake.items = append(fake.items, item)
	return nil
}

type relationCall struct {
	parentID, childID string
	order             int
}

type relationRepositoryFake struct {
	repository.CourseModuleRepository
	repository.ModuleSectionRepository
	repository.SectionLessonRepository
	calls []relationCall
}

func (fake *relationRepositoryFake) Add(_ context.Context, parentID string, childID string, order int) error {
	fake.calls = append(fake.calls, relationCall{parentID: parentID, childID: childID, order: order})
	return nil
}

func (*relationRepositoryFake) Delete(context.Context, string, string) error { return nil }

type i18nRepositoryFake struct {
	repository.I18nRepository
	entry domain.I18n
}

func (fake *i18nRepositoryFake) Create(_ context.Context, item domain.I18n) error {
	fake.entry = domain.I18n{ID: 1, Language: item.Language}
	return nil
}

func (fake *i18nRepositoryFake) GetByLanguage(_ context.Context, language string) (*domain.I18n, error) {
	if fake.entry.Language != language {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	result := fake.entry
	return &result, nil
}

type transactionFake struct{}

func (transactionFake) WithTx(ctx context.Context, callback func(context.Context) error) error {
	return callback(ctx)
}

type sequenceIDs struct {
	values []string
	index  int
}

func (ids *sequenceIDs) NewID() string {
	value := ids.values[ids.index]
	ids.index++
	return value
}

type fixedClock struct{ value time.Time }

func (clock fixedClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.value }
